title: Niagara Beyond the Falls Walking Tour and Cruise Seasonal
includes: Entry or admission fee to Niagara City Cruises (Boat - seasonal)
Accredited Tour guide in your chosen language.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: The Niagara Beyond the Falls Walking Tour and Cruise (Seasonal) takes adventure seekers and families to Journey Behind the Falls, guided by an experienced and certified tour guide. Guests gain insider knowledge of local history, experience immersive cultural moments, and finish with a thrilling boat ride up close to the powerful Horseshoe Falls.
